notes: Strong early HQ/R&D pressure stole 6 points, but then repeatedly ran into known unbreakable Piranhas and Starlit Knight with no breaker, installed a second unique Docklands Pass, and sat at 0-1 credits for many turns burning clicks on tags.
Coherent score-out plan; the first agenda was installed and advanced over two turns in a naked remote, which only worked because the Runner never ran.

After a good start, ran into known Afshar eight times with no breaker losing credits, then clicked for credits every click from turn 9 to 46 credits while the Corp scored 7 points out of a remote without any challenge.
Solid scoring remote and good use of Ansel/Tithe; Megaprix was stolen from a single-ice remote while too poor to rez, and the economy ran very thin at times.
Sensible pressure with Tremolo and Sang Kancil, good remote checks and tag management; a few slightly passive credit turns.
Scored out from a deep remote, but spent most of the game at 0-3 credits clicking for money, could not rez ice when Superconducting Hub was stolen, and repeatedly discarded at end of turn.
Relentless R&D pressure through tag-only Vasilisa won quickly; carried a large tag pile against an NBN deck, which was risky but unpunished.
Spammed unprotected R&D with repeat runs that mostly re-accessed the same top card, then sat clicking credits to 17 with no fracter while the Corp scored three agendas from a one-ice remote.
Kept installing agendas into a remote guarded only by a non-ETR Bathynomus and lost four in a row; also wasted a Neurospike for nothing and left two clicks unused on turn 4.
Saisentan-protected remote scored two agendas and punished the Runner into a flatline; economy was thin but adequate.
Steady remote scoring with reasonable ice; slow start clicking for credits and Oppo Research tags were never capitalised on.
Built a working rig and multi-accessed HQ to win; some passive midgame credit clicking and a low-credit run into a four-ice remote that happened to work.

Installed and advanced Next Big Thing at 0 credits so none of the remote ice could be rezzed, and never reinforced R&D beyond a single Paywall while clicking for credits and discarding late, losing three agendas there.
Reasonable early game, but from turn 15 clicked for credits to 35 while the Corp advanced cards in remotes, and on the last turn ignored a freshly installed agenda behind one ice that won the game.
Efficient R&D/HQ pressure with Revolver and Tremolo for a fast win; checking naked remotes against Jinteki cost cards but was a reasonable gamble.

Clicked for credits nearly every click from turn 7 to 47 credits while holding a full hand and discarding each turn, never installing an agenda into its four-ice remote; agendas rotting in HQ were stolen.
Won through R&D and a remote steal, but ran into the same recurring Descent on HQ several turns with no decoder and installed a second Buzzsaw.

Scored two Yagi-Udas early, then dropped to 0 credits, installed Sericulture behind a single Tatu-Bola it could not afford to rez, and spent clicks icing servers holding only already-revealed Urtica Ciphers.
Ansel kept HQ agendas safe and Wage Workers/Seamless Launch enabled fast scores; somewhat passive credit clicking on turns 3-4.
Clicked for credits almost every click to 56 credits, never built a rig or pressured centrals, and even let a Paywall end the run rather than pay 1 credit while the Corp scored out.
